title: Optional TaviX manifest.assetDependencies request (NOT an authorization grant)
description: Validate this field and the matching manifest.permissions before staging. The host must separately approve a subset of the requested packs, capabilities and preference writes.

requestCustomization.description: Requests preference-write permission for this pack; user consent and host grant are still required.

$comment: Cross-field rules not expressible in this fragment: unique packId; min < maxExclusive; union of capabilities <=256; manifest permissions include assets.read, and assets.preferences.write iff any requestCustomization is true. Enforced by tools/tavix_asset_dependencies.py.
